title: REQ · validateWorld reports unknown scene character ids with a path-tagged issue
summary: validateWorld checks every scene.characters[i].id against world.characters
description: Context: validateWorld iterates scenes but skips scene.characters. Desired behavior: for each scene and each index, an id missing from the world's character list adds scenes[<sceneId>].characters[<index>].id: unknown character <id>. Expected result: world content validation fails on dangling NPC ids and passes on valid ones. Why: prevents NPCs referencing undeclared characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene bedroom with characters [{id:'ghost'}] and a world listing only boy, when validateWorld runs, then errors contain 'scenes[bedroom].characters[0].id: unknown character ghost'
Given a scene whose characters are all listed in world.characters, when validateWorld runs, then errors is empty
Given a scene with no characters field, when validateWorld runs, then no character error is added
